findings.why: 8,303 cells of the 1227 shape lay in the Eastern Xia kingdom (independent 1217-1233, conquered by Guyuk 1233); 4,677 cells were the Khwarazmian rump in western Iran (to 1231); Hebei, Shanxi and Shandong (1,955 cells, ledger gain 1223, 'rooted out all resistance ... from 1217 to 1223') were missing from Cliopatria's 1227 shape. Not changed: Sakha (Yakutia) 2,192 and Irkutsk/Chita/Buryat parts of the shape (no page opened gives or denies them); the 10,084 cells kept by ulus-of-jochi and ulus-of-chagatai are those uluses' own.

The 1236 shape adds Qinghai 998, Gansu 334 and the northern forest zone (Perm 586, Sverdlovsk 548, Kirov 462, Komi 326). Tibet page: before 1240 only Subutai's 1225-1227 conquest of the Sarigh Uyghurs west of Koko Nor, silent on Qinghai/Amdo rule; Volga Bulgaria page: Bashkiria subjugated 1232, upper Ural valley 1229, silent on Perm, Kirov, Komi, Sverdlovsk. Nothing dated enough to add or subtract; the 1231 and 1233 gains added for F009/F011 already shrink the snap (western Iran and Manchuria no longer arrive at 1236). Removed side (436 cells) left.

Iltutmish annexed 'large parts of Punjab and Sindh' in 1228 and the coastal wali recognised him; a Soomra king 'submitted to Iltutmish ... and was allowed to continue as a vassal' (undated), Soomra 'probably centered in lower Sindh', boundaries unknown. The size rule gives the cells to the Soomra, which is the vassal reading; no page draws a Delhi-Soomra line, so no dossier edit. Optional tint handoff written for mamluk-dynasty.
